subject.title: Discord turns can be missed or finish silently across gateway restart/recovery on 2026.6.10

question: After the v2026.6.11-era reconnect and pre-connect mitigations, should #98081 remain the broad live Discord recovery bundle or be split/closed into narrower canonical issues?
rationale: The remaining failure modes cross inbound replay, outbound duplicate-safety, final visible delivery, and cron/task recovery, and the safe default behavior is a product/reliability contract choice rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Keep as live recovery bundle
options.body: Keep #98081 open until a current-main or next-release Discord/Docker repro confirms which restart/recovery gaps remain, then split or link exact leftovers.

options.title: Split into existing canonical issues
options.body: Move inbound catch-up to #55792, final delivery semantics to #87561, and send_attempt_started recovery to #95548 or #87552 after confirming no unique cron/task gap remains.

options.title: Close after partial fixes
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept that the recent reconnect/pre-connect fixes sufficiently address the user-visible v2026.6.10 report without another live proof pass.

recommendation.title: Keep as live recovery bundle
recommendation.body: Keep #98081 open until a current-main or next-release Discord/Docker repro confirms which restart/recovery gaps remain, then split or link exact leftovers.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is tied by history to the durable outbound lifecycle, Discord reconnect, and current recovery/adapter surfaces most central to the decision.
